title: Automation Anywhere Work Item
description: Schema representing a work item within the Automation Anywhere Workload Management system. A work item is a single unit of data queued for processing by an RPA bot, with a typed payload defined by the queue's work item model and lifecycle status tracking from creation through completion.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the work item assigned by the Control Room upon creation

queueId.description: Numeric ID of the Workload Management queue this work item belongs to

json.description: Key-value data payload of the work item. Keys are attribute names defined in the queue's work item model; values are the actual data to be processed by the bot.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the work item indicating where it is in the processing pipeline

result.description: Processing outcome recorded by the bot upon completing or failing this work item

col1.description: Display column 1: a human-readable label extracted from the work item data for display in the Control Room queue viewer

col2.description: Display column 2: a secondary human-readable label extracted from the work item data

col3.description: Display column 3: a tertiary human-readable label extracted from the work item data

deviceId.description: Numeric ID of the Bot Runner device that processed or is currently processing this work item

deviceUserId.description: Numeric ID of the user account under which the processing bot executed on the device

automationId.description: Deployment ID (UUID) of the automation that processed this work item, linking back to the deployment record

jobExecutionId.description: Identifier of the job execution associated with processing this work item

startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bot began processing this work item

endTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when bot processing of this work item completed

deferredUntil.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which this work item is deferred; the bot will not pick it up before this time

lastPausedTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the work item was last paused during processing

totalPausedTime.description: Total time in seconds this work item was in a paused state

comment.description: Optional free-text comment added by the processing bot or a human operator

error.description: Error message recorded when the work item processing failed, for debugging and retry decisions

retryCount.description: Number of times this work item has been automatically retried after failure

hashCode.description: Hash of the work item data used for duplicate detection when disallowDuplicate is enabled on the queue

version.description: Optimistic concurrency control version number; must match the server value when updating

tenantUuid.description: UUID of the tenant in a multi-tenant Control Room deployment

createdBy.description: Numeric ID of the user who created this work item

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this work item was added to the queue

updatedBy.description: Numeric ID of the user who last modified this work item

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last status or data update to this work item

WorkItemModel.description: Schema definition for work items in a queue, specifying the named attributes and their data types that each work item must contain

id.description: Unique identifier of the work item model

name.description: Human-readable name for the work item model

attributes.description: Ordered list of attribute definitions that form the work item data schema

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this model was created

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this model

WorkItemAttribute.description: A single named attribute definition within a work item model

name.description: Attribute name used as the key in work item JSON payloads

type.description: Data type of values stored in this attribute

isRequired.description: Whether this attribute must be provided when creating a work item

Queue.description: A work item queue configuration in the Workload Management system

description.description: Optional description of the queue's business purpose

workItemModelId.description: ID of the work item model defining the data schema for items in this queue

status.description: Current operational status of the queue

reactivationThreshold.description: Percentage of remaining work items below which the queue triggers reactivation of bot processing

disallowDuplicate.description: Whether to reject work items that have the same data hash as an existing item in the queue

autoRetryLimit.description: Maximum number of automatic retries for failed work items before they are marked as permanently failed

workItemProcessingOrders.description: Ordered list of attribute names by which work items are prioritized for processing
